id.description: Optional. The service generates a stable ID when omitted.

driver.description: An installed adapter name or Python module:Class. Read /v1/adapters.

config.description: Driver-specific connection settings and named operations.

timeout.description: Maximum operation duration in seconds; default 300.

startup_timeout.description: Driver startup and description timeout in seconds; default 30.

cancel_timeout.description: Time to finish cancellation before the SDK process ends; default 2.
